sentences.en: Palm oil is an edible oil derived from the fruit of the African oil palm tree, and is currently the most consumed vegetable oil in the world.
sentences.zh: 棕榈油是一种从非洲油棕树果实中提取的食用油，也是目前世界上消费量最大的植物油。

sentences.en: It’s almost certainly in the soap we wash with in the morning, the sandwich we have for lunch, and the biscuits we snack on during the day.
sentences.zh: 我们清早洗漱用的肥皂、午餐吃的三明治，以及白天当零食的饼干，几乎肯定都含有棕榈油。

sentences.en: Why is palm oil so attractive for manufacturers?
sentences.zh: 为什么棕榈油对生产商如此有吸引力？

sentences.en: Primarily because its unique properties — such as remaining solid at room temperature — make it an ideal ingredient for long-term preservation, allowing many packaged foods on supermarket shelves to have ‘best before’ dates of months, even years, into the future.
sentences.zh: 主要是因为它具有独特的性质，例如在室温下仍保持固态，因此很适合用在需要长期保存的产品里。许多超市货架上的包装食品因而可以把“最佳食用日期”定在几个月甚至几年之后。

sentences.en: Many farmers have seized the opportunity to maximise the planting of oil palm trees.
sentences.zh: 许多农户抓住这一机会，尽可能多地种植油棕树。

sentences.en: Between 1990 and 2012, the global land area devoted to growing oil palm trees grew from 6 to 17 million hectares, now accounting for around ten percent of total cropland in the entire world.
sentences.zh: 1990年至2012年间，全球油棕的种植面积从600万公顷增至1,700万公顷，如今约占全球耕地总面积的10%。

sentences.en: From a mere two million tonnes of palm oil being produced annually globally 50 years ago, there are now around 60 million tonnes produced every single year, a figure looking likely to double or even triple by the middle of the century.
sentences.zh: 五十年前，全球棕榈油年产量仅为200万吨，如今每年约产6,000万吨。到本世纪中叶，这一数字看来很可能增至目前的两倍，甚至三倍。

sentences.en: However, there are multiple reasons why conservationists cite the rapid spread of oil palm plantations as a major concern.
sentences.zh: 然而，自然保护人士将油棕种植园迅速扩张列为重大隐忧，理由有很多。

sentences.en: There are countless news stories of deforestation, habitat destruction and dwindling species populations, all as a direct result of land clearing to establish oil palm tree monoculture on an industrial scale, particularly in Malaysia and Indonesia.
sentences.zh: 有关森林砍伐、栖息地破坏和物种种群数量下降的新闻不计其数。这些都是清理土地、以工业规模单一种植油棕树的直接后果，马来西亚和印度尼西亚尤其如此。

sentences.en: Endangered species — most famously the Sumatran orangutan, but also rhinos, elephants, tigers, and numerous other fauna — have suffered from the unstoppable spread of oil palm plantations.
sentences.zh: 油棕种植园势不可挡地扩张，已使濒危物种受到伤害。最广为人知的例子是苏门答腊猩猩，受影响的还有犀牛、大象、老虎及许多其他动物。

sentences.en: ‘Palm oil is surely one of the greatest threats to global biodiversity,’ declares Dr Farnon Ellwood of the University of the West of England, Bristol.
sentences.zh: “棕榈油无疑是全球生物多样性面临的最大威胁之一，”布里斯托尔西英格兰大学的法农·埃尔伍德博士说。

sentences.en: ‘Palm oil is replacing rainforest, and rainforest is where all the species are.
sentences.zh: “棕榈油正在取代雨林，而各种生物恰恰就栖居在雨林里。

sentences.en: That’s a problem.’
sentences.zh: 这就是问题所在。”

sentences.en: This has led to some radical questions among environmentalists, such as whether consumers should try to boycott palm oil entirely.
sentences.zh: 这让环保人士提出了一些激进的问题，比如消费者是否应当尝试彻底抵制棕榈油。

sentences.en: Meanwhile Bhavani Shankar, Professor at London’s School of Oriental and African Studies, argues, ‘It’s easy to say that palm oil is the enemy and we should be against it.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，伦敦大学亚非学院教授巴瓦尼·尚卡尔认为：“说棕榈油是敌人、我们理应反对它，这很容易。

sentences.en: It makes for a more dramatic story, and it’s very intuitive.
sentences.zh: 这样说，故事更有戏剧性，也很符合直觉。

sentences.en: But given the complexity of the argument, I think a much more nuanced story is closer to the truth.’
sentences.zh: 可是，考虑到这场争论相当复杂，我认为，更能体现细微差别的说法才更接近事实。”

sentences.en: One response to the boycott movement has been the argument for the vital role palm oil plays in lifting many millions of people in the developing world out of poverty.
sentences.zh: 对于抵制运动，一种回应是指出，棕榈油在帮助发展中国家数以百万计的人摆脱贫困方面发挥着至关重要的作用。

sentences.en: Is it desirable to have palm oil boycotted, replaced, eliminated from the global supply chain, given how many low-income people in developing countries depend on it for their livelihoods?
sentences.zh: 发展中国家有那么多低收入者依赖棕榈油维持生计，考虑到这一点，抵制棕榈油、用其他产品取代它、将它从全球供应链中剔除，真的可取吗？

sentences.en: How best to strike a utilitarian balance between these competing factors has become a serious bone of contention.
sentences.zh: 如何权衡这些相互冲突的因素，使总体效益最大，已经成了一个重要争议点。

sentences.en: Even the deforestation argument isn’t as straightforward as it seems.
sentences.zh: 即使是有关毁林的论点，也不像表面上那么简单。

sentences.en: Oil palm plantations produce at least four and potentially up to ten times more oil per hectare than soybean, rapeseed, sunflower or other competing oils.
sentences.zh: 油棕每公顷的出油量至少是大豆、油菜籽、向日葵等竞争性油料作物的四倍，最高可能达十倍。

sentences.en: That immensely high yield — which is predominantly what makes it so profitable — is potentially also an ecological benefit.
sentences.zh: 这种极高的产量正是油棕如此赚钱的主要原因，同时也可能是一项生态上的优势。

sentences.en: If ten times more palm oil can be produced from a patch of land than any competing oil, then ten times more land would need to be cleared in order to produce the same volume of oil from that competitor.
sentences.zh: 假如同一块地生产的棕榈油是其他任何一种竞争油料产油量的十倍，那么要用这种替代作物生产等量的油，就得清理十倍面积的土地。

sentences.en: As for the question of carbon emissions, the issue really depends on what oil palm trees are replacing.
sentences.zh: 至于碳排放问题，关键其实在于油棕树取代的是什么。

sentences.en: Crops vary in the degree to which they sequester carbon — in other words, the amount of carbon they capture from the atmosphere and store within the plant.
sentences.zh: 不同作物的固碳能力各异；换言之，它们从大气中吸收并储存在植株里的碳量并不相同。

sentences.en: The more carbon a plant sequesters, the more it reduces the effect of climate change.
sentences.zh: 一种植物固定的碳越多，就越能减轻气候变化的影响。

sentences.en: As Shankar explains: ‘[Palm oil production] actually sequesters more carbon in some ways than other alternatives. [...]
sentences.zh: 正如尚卡尔解释的那样：“在某些方面，[棕榈油生产]实际上比其他替代方案固定的碳更多。［……］

sentences.en: Of course, if you’re cutting down virgin forest it’s terrible — that’s what’s happening in Indonesia and Malaysia, it’s been allowed to get out of hand.
sentences.zh: 当然，如果砍伐的是原始森林，那就糟透了。印度尼西亚和马来西亚发生的正是这种事，而且人们放任局势失去了控制。

sentences.en: But if it’s replacing rice, for example, it might actually sequester more carbon.’
sentences.zh: 但如果它取代的是水稻之类的作物，实际固定的碳倒可能更多。”

sentences.en: The industry is now regulated by a group called the Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO), consisting of palm growers, retailers, product manufacturers, and other interested parties.
sentences.zh: 目前该行业由可持续棕榈油圆桌倡议（RSPO）这一组织监管，其成员包括油棕种植者、零售商、产品制造商和其他利益相关方。

sentences.en: Over the past decade or so, an agreement has gradually been reached regarding standards that producers of palm oil have to meet in order for their product to be regarded as officially ‘sustainable’.
sentences.zh: 过去十来年间，人们逐渐就一套标准达成协议：棕榈油生产者必须达到这些标准，其产品才能获得“可持续”的正式认定。

sentences.en: The RSPO insists upon no virgin forest clearing, transparency and regular assessment of carbon stocks, among other criteria.
sentences.zh: 该组织要求不得砍伐原始森林，须保持透明，并定期评估碳储量，此外还有其他标准。

sentences.en: Only once these requirements are fully satisfied is the oil allowed to be sold as certified sustainable palm oil (CSPO).
sentences.zh: 只有在这些要求全部得到满足后，棕榈油才能以“经认证的可持续棕榈油”（CSPO）的名义销售。

sentences.en: Recent figures show that the RSPO now certifies around 12 million tonnes of palm oil annually, equivalent to roughly 21 percent of the world’s total palm oil production.
sentences.zh: 近期数据显示，该组织目前每年认证约1,200万吨棕榈油，相当于全球棕榈油总产量的约21%。

sentences.en: There is even hope that oil palm plantations might not need to be such sterile monocultures, or ‘green deserts’, as Ellwood describes them.
sentences.zh: 甚至有人希望，油棕种植园并不一定非得是生物种类如此贫乏的单一种植区，或者用埃尔伍德的话说，非得是“绿色沙漠”。

sentences.en: New research at Ellwood’s lab hints at one plant which might make all the difference.
sentences.zh: 埃尔伍德实验室的新研究提示，有一种植物或许能带来决定性的改变。

sentences.en: The bird’s nest fern (Asplenium nidus) grows on trees in an epiphytic fashion (meaning it’s dependent on the tree only for support, not for nutrients), and is native to many tropical regions, where as a keystone species it performs a vital ecological role.
sentences.zh: 鸟巢蕨（Asplenium nidus）附生在树上，也就是说，它只利用树木作支撑，并不从树中获取养分。它原产于许多热带地区，在那里作为关键物种发挥着重要的生态作用。

sentences.en: Ellwood believes that reintroducing the bird’s nest fern into oil palm plantations could potentially allow these areas to recover their biodiversity, providing a home for all manner of species, from fungi and bacteria, to invertebrates such as insects, amphibians, reptiles and even mammals.
sentences.zh: 埃尔伍德认为，将鸟巢蕨重新引入油棕种植园，可能有助于这些地区恢复生物多样性，为各种生物提供栖身之处，其中有真菌和细菌，有昆虫这样的无脊椎动物，还有两栖动物、爬行动物乃至哺乳动物。
